node.title: Re: How to print data between tags from file sequentially?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I have a text file

Are you sure it's a text file? It looks like XML (or maybe HTML?) to me. Even if just a section of a longer text file contains XML data, I would strongly recommend extracting that section of text and using a proper module to parse it (see e.g. [id://1201438] for why). [mod://Mojo::DOM] has a nice interface, and it handles even this case of the XML not having a root node:

use warnings; use strict; use Mojo::DOM; my $html = <<'END_HTML'; ServerName 10.10.10.11 Windows Server 2012 END_HTML # note: ->xml(1) turns on case sensitivity my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new->xml(1)->parse($html); my $values = $dom->find('Answer')->map('all_text'); print "Computer: $values->[0]\n"; print "IP Address: $values->[1]\n"; print "OS: $values->[2]\n";
